english.note: Use this when someone is strongly captivated or enchanted by something.
Use this when someone or something fascinates or bewitches a person and holds their attention.

examples.english: That cat can fascinate everyone in the room.
examples.traditional: 嗰隻貓一出場就迷住晒全場嘅人。
